column1: # The nine components 05-testing-and-release.md §1 holds to 98% region coverage.
# This is the one place in the repo they are named. Each row maps a component to the
# source it is measured over; ci/check-coverage.sh reads this file and nothing else.
# A component whose module does not exist yet matches no file, so it has no regions and
# the gate says so — a name with no regions, never a hole in the list. That is the whole
# point of wiring the gate before core has code: no later slice negotiates a gate with
# the code it is supposed to judge.
# The paths are ours (module names are routine Rust mechanics), the names are the spec's.
# Renaming a module means editing the regex here in the same commit, or the component
# silently drops back to "no regions yet" and the 98% floor stops applying to it.
# Format: name<TAB>regex, matched against the absolute path llvm-cov reports.
PSBT validation and the whole rejection policy
Derivation and the change re-derivation byte-compare
Sighash computation and the signing call into secp256k1
The entropy mixing function
BIP39 mnemonic ↔ entropy conversion and checksum (including passphrase handling and NFKD)
Backup crypto — Argon2id parameters, ChaCha20-Poly1305, header and AAD framing
The UR decode clamping wrapper and the payload-class check
The zeroizing secret types
Address and amount formatting
